_about: Recency-weighted recall (trinity-enterprise#1022). Facts carry an age in days relative to `now`; each query names the fact that must rank first, the facts that must be in the top k, and the ones that must not surface. Evaluated by tests/unit/ent1022_recency_eval.py against the real embedding model inside the backend image.

The Q4 budget review moved to Monday 2 November.
Deploys go to staging first, then to production after the smoke test passes.

queries.name: superseded deadline: the newer revision ranks first
queries.query: When is the Q4 budget review due?

queries.query: How do we deploy to production?

queries.name: report cadence: the current one beats the historical one
queries.query: When do the weekly reports go out?
